$comment: The Boat template for a fresh raubot box. build.ts installs this on a clean sandbox and saves it as the named snapshot raubot-box-<hash>; set BOAT_TEMPLATE to that name.

egress.$comment: Default deny. Allowed: loopback, replies, Boat's WireGuard endpoint and agent port 8911, the system resolvers, then these ports. deny wins over the port list.
